norm_perturbation.generator: dedicated torch.Generator (does not consume the global model-init RNG)
norm_perturbation.draw_order: model.modules() order, weight then bias per norm
norm_perturbation.note: every norm affine is perturbed before the checkpoint is saved so the 24 norms are mutually distinct and the strict golden discriminates the composite model's norm wiring

provenance.key_layout_note: the full Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration state dict already carries the real artifact key scheme (model.visual.*, model.language_model.*); the tied lm_head.weight is dropped, so all 104 tensors are stored as bfloat16 (35 text + 69 vision)
provenance.tied_head_note: tie_word_embeddings is true and the checkpoint stores no lm_head tensor; the reference model applies the config-declared tie (4.57.6's from_pretrained-only _tie_or_clone_weights, applied explicitly) before loading the 104 stored tensors
provenance.reference_dtype_note: the checkpoint config declares text dtype bfloat16 (matching the stored bf16 tensors), but the golden is a genuine CPU float32 reference: the reference model is built with text_config.dtype overridden to float32 and loads the stored bf16 weights upconverted to float32 -- the exact path the Java composite model takes when it upcasts the checkpoint
provenance.decode_reference_note: every decode and forced step's logits are a fresh full uncached forward over the original expanded prompt plus the generated history, computed with the explicit reference path: the tower runs once from the original pixel values, image rows and DeepStack levels are applied only at the original prompt's image-token destinations, and the positions are the recorded prefill axes followed by logicalPosition + delta. Token-based placeholder detection and get_rope_index are never re-run over generated markers; the explicit path is pinned against the standard processor forward at the zero-history point (1e-6)
provenance.deepstack_note: two DeepStack levels (vision extraction indices [1, 3]) are injected after decoder blocks 0 and 1; the third decoder layer is un-injected, so every injection position kind is exercised
provenance.position_note: num_position_embeddings is 64 (an 8 x 8 learned table) while grids reach 12 along one axis, so the bilinear fast_pos_embed_interpolate runs beyond the table on both images; mrope_section [16, 8, 8] is a strictly unequal split with 2 * sum = 64 = head_dim

processor.note: transformers 4.57.6 has no Qwen3VLImageProcessor class; the slow PIL Qwen2VLImageProcessor is the pinned preprocessing path. min_pixels/max_pixels are passed explicitly because the 4.57.6 __init__ overwrites any size dict with the 3136/1003520 defaults (findings Section 4.2). Images are passed as file path strings so the load_image (exif_transpose) path matches the Java processFile path; all areas lie inside [3136, 12845056] so smart_resize is a no-op.
